title: Board Policy on Capital Credits: Discount Horizon of an Estate's Elected Pass-Through Rows
content:
# Discount Horizon of an Estate's Elected Pass-Through Rows

**Policy — Capital Credits (Patronage Capital).** The estate pass-through discount horizon is the row's whole years from its expected rotation — the whole calendar years from the year of the election to the year the row would be retired in the general rotation on its expected rotation, never fewer than zero — transformed as follows:

1. a row at least **25** whole years away is discounted over 25 years only;
2. a row no more than **2** whole years away is not discounted at all;
3. any other row is discounted over its whole years.

## Horizon by distance

| Whole years from expected rotation | Horizon |
|---|---|
| 31 | 25 years |
| 25 | 25 years |
| 24 | 24 years |
| 3 | 3 years |
| 2 | none — paid at full value |
| 0 | none — paid at full value |

The horizon of these rows is always a whole number of years.
